description: Estimates a whole destination wedding budget in USD by guest count, place and style tier, from Aisle’s modelled wedding cost index. Accepts a destination or a country; a destination without a row of its own is priced at its country and the result says so. Results include a line-by-line breakdown, a typical total and the range most weddings land in. Places the index does not cover return coverage information. Figures are modelled estimates, not supplier quotes or prices from booked weddings.

country.description: Country name, used when no destination slug is given. Priced from that country as a whole.

destination.description: Place slug for a destination or a country in Aisle’s wedding cost index, such as amalfi-coast, tuscany, santorini, italy or mexico. A destination without a row of its own, such as tulum or bali, is priced at its country and the result says so.

name: get_budget_estimate
title: Wedding Budget Estimator
